puM, (pari samantAt cayanaM boDo jYAnamityarTaH । pari + ci + ap .) viSezeRa jYAnam । cenA iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । saMstavaH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 23 ॥ praRayaH 3 । iti BarataH ॥ (yaTA, mAGe । 7 । 61 । “na paricayo malinAtmanAM prasADanam ॥” aByAsaH । yaTA, mAGe । 2 । 75 । “hetuH paricayasTEryye vaktarguRanikEva sA ॥” nAdasya avasTAviSezaH । yaTA, haWayogadIpikAyAm । 4 । 69 । “AramBaSca GawaScEva taTA paricayo'pi ca । nizpattiH sarvvayogezu syAdavasTAcatuzwayam ॥”)
v: pu॰ pari + ci--ac । 1 jYAtasya pOnaHpunyena jYAne saMstave 2 paRaye ca amaraH । 3 sarvataScayane mAGaH 2 । 75 ।
m: परि-चय &c. See under परि- √ 1. 2. चि.
1. परि-चय m. heaping up, accumulation, Kauś.
2. परि-चय m. acquaintance, intimacy, familiarity with, knowledge of (gen. loc. instr. with or sc. समम्, or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
trial, practice, frequent repetition, Kāv. (cf. रति-प्˚)
meeting with a friend, W.
a: परिचयः — 1 Heaping up, accumulation. --2 Acquaintance, familiarity, intimacy; पुरुषपरिचयेन Mk. 1. 56; अतिपरिचयादवज्ञा ‘familiarity breeds contempt’; परिचयं चललक्ष्यनिपातने R. 9. 49; सकलकलापरिचयः K. 76. --3 Trial, study, practice, frequent repetition; हेतुः परिचयस्थैर्ये वक्तुर्गुणनिकैव सा Śi. 2. 75; 11. 5; वर्णपरिचयं करोति Ś. 5. --4 Recognition; Me. 9. --Comp. --करुणा increasing love or tenderness; Māl. 6. 16.

k.v: संस्तवः स्यात्परिचयः प्रसरस्तु विसर्पणम्. नीवाकस्तु प्रयामः स्यात्सन्निधिः सन्निकर्षणम्.।

m: 1. परि-चयनीय mfn. to be collected or accumulated, W.
2. परि-चयनीय mfn. to be known, W.
परि-चय—वत् mfn. being at its height, complete, finished, Mālav. iii, 20.
परि-चेतस् mfn. faint-hearted, despondent, ib.
1. परि-चेतव्य mfn. to be collected together, W.
2. परि-चेतव्य or परि-चेय, mfn. to be known; to be investigated or searched, W.

s: pariceyaM
tri, pari pUrvvaciDAtoH karmmaRi yapratyayena nizpannam ॥ paricayayogyam । paricayanIyam । paricetavyam ॥
m: 1. परि-चेय mfn. to be collected all round or from every side, ib.
परि-√ चृत् P. -चृतति (ind.p. -चृत्य), to wind round; to tie or fasten together, Kauś.

परि-√ 1. चि P. Ā. -चिनोति, ˚नुते, to pile up, ŚBr.; to surround or enclose with (instr.), Śulb.; to heap up, accumulate, augment, increase, RV. &c. &c.: Pass. -चीयते, to be increased or augmented, to grow, Ragh.

परि-√ 2. चि (2. sg. Impv. -चिनु; p. -चिन्वत्; inf. -चेतुम्), to examine, investigate, search, MBh.; R.; to find out, know, learn, exercise, practise, become acquainted with (acc.), Kāv.; Rājat.; Pañc. : Pass. -चीयते, Kāv.; Hit. : Caus. Ā. -चाययते, to search, seek for, Kāv.
a: परिचि — {vI.v} {c5c} U. 1 To heap up, accumulate. --2 To know; Mv. 7. 11. --3 To get, acquire. --4 To increase. --5 To cover or fill with. {vII.v} {c3c} P. 1 To practise, familiarize oneself with. --2 To become acquainted with. --3 Ved. To examine, investigate. --Caus. To search, seek for. --Pass. To grow, be developed; R. 3. 24.
परिचिंत् — {c10c} U. 1 To think, consider, judge; त्वमेव तावत्परिचिंतय स्वयं कदचिदेते यदि योगमर्हतः Ku. 5. 67; Bg. 10. 17. --2 To think of, remember, call to mind. --3 To devise, find out.
परिचिंतनं — Thinking of, remembering.

m: परि-चिह्नित mfn. marked, signed, subscribed, MBh.; Yājñ.
परि-√ चिन्त् P. -चिन्तयति (ind.p. -चिन्त्य), to think about, meditate on, reflect, consider, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to call to mind, remember, ib.; to devise, invent, ib.
परि-चिन्तक mfn. reflecting about, meditating on (gen. or comp.), MBh.; BhP.
परि-चिन्तनीय mfn. to be well considered, Kāv.
परि-चिन्तित mfn. thought of, found out, R.

v: tri॰ paritaScIyate ci--karmaRi kvip । 1 paritaH sTApite yaju॰ 12 । 46 karttari kvip । 2 paricayakarttari tri॰ ।
m: परि-चित् mfn. piling up or arranging all around, VS.

s: paricitaH

tri, (pari + ci + karmmaRi ktaH .) paricayaviSizwaH । jYAtaH । yaTA, -- “tyaktavyeyaM ciraparicitA janmaBUmIti budDyA mA Kidyasva triBuvanajanatrARahetoH kramANka ! । kinna tyAjyaM Bavati mahatAM cet parasyopakArI । vArARasyA munirapi gato dakziRASAmagastyaH ॥” iti padANkadUtaH ॥
v: tri॰ pari + ci--karmaRi kta । 1 paricayayukte 2 tatkarmaRi ।
m: 1. परि-चित mfn. heaped up, accumulated, gathered, Megh.; Rājat.; BhP.
(with instr.) filled with, containing, BhP.
2. परि-चित mfn. known, familiar (˚तं-√ कृ, to make a person's acquaintance), Hariv.; Kāv.
a: परिचित — p. p. 1 Heaped up, accumulated. --2 Familiar, intimate or acquainted with; Ś. 5. 10. --3 Learnt, practised.

m: परि-चित—भू mfn. having (its) place well known, MW.
परि-चित—विविक्त mfn. familiarised to seclusion, Śak. v, 10.
परि-चिति f. acquaintance, familiarity, intimacy, Śāntiś.
a: परिचितिः — f. Acquaintance, familiarity, intimacy.

m: परि-चोदित mfn. set in motion, brandished, Hariv.
impelled, incited, MBh.

a: परिचुंब् — {c1c} P. To kiss passionately; परिचुंब्य चूतमंजरीं Ś. 5. 1; Rs. 6. 17; Amaru. 77.
परिचुंबनं — Kissing passionately; Śi. 7. 63.

m: परि-√ चुद् Caus. -चोदयति, to set in motion, urge, impel, exhort, Mn. iii, 233.
परि-√ चुम्ब् P. -चुम्बति (ind.p. -चुम्ब्य), to kiss heartily or passionately, cover with kisses, Kāv.; to touch closely, ib.
परि-चुम्बन n. the act of kissing heartily &c., Bālar.; Caurap.
परि-चुम्बित mfn. kissed passionately or touched closely, Caurap.
परि-च्यवन n. (√ च्यु) descending from heaven (to be born as a man), HPariś.
loss, deprivation of (abl.), Āpast., Sch.

a: परिच्यु — {c1c} A. 1 To go away or fly off from, escape. --2 To proceed from. --3 To swerve, fall off from, deviate, leave. --4 To lose. be deprived of, --5 To drop or fall down. --6 To be displaced or ejected from. --7 To be freed from. --8 To come down, descend.

m: परि-च्युत mfn. fallen or descended from (abl.), MBh.; Kāv.
fallen from heaven (to be born as a man), HPariś.
swerved or deviated from (abl.), R.
deprived or rid of (abl.), Gaut.; MBh.; Pur.
ruined, lost, miserable (opp. to सम्-ऋद्ध), MBh.
streaming with (instr.), ib.
परि-च्युति f. falling down, Kathās.
a: परिच्युतिः — f. 1 Falling down. --2 Swerving, deviating.
